smell_validity.evidence: One exported singleton fuses seven unrelated domains — device breakpoints, off-canvas CSS, menu styling, popper positioning, keyboard policies, tree-state transitions, inert handling — consulted by seven modules even for key equalities. Concentrating every decision in one class and the boundary from per-concern ownership are unmistakable; the fault is cohesion across change-reasons, not mere size.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Styling, responsive, positioning, keyboard and tree-state changes all land in one file, coupling unrelated edits and forcing readers through other domains to follow one behavior; understanding and change-safety both suffer. Dissolving it restores per-concern ownership across all consumers. Within each family the centralization keeps one source, so harm is coupling and cognition, not inconsistency.

development_plausibility.evidence: Every relocated decision is verbatim functioning logic with no filler; comments carry real domain subtleties (SSR-safe subscription, React 18/19 inert forms, sibling-commit registration) and construction is import-safe. The class reads as the natural endpoint of successive maintenance waves centralizing repeatedly-touched rules — indistinguishable from ordinary repository evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The contract names the concentration, every concern family and consumer, forbids renames, pass-through hubs, media-hook rerouting and test edits, and pins checkable invariants: exact warning text, SSR-false first render, cleanup, hook boundary, import safety. It decisively blocks incomplete cleanup, wrong direction and irrelevant redesign while leaving homes and internals open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Relocation spans styling templates, SSR-safe media subscription, popper instance lifecycle, keyboard policies, tree-state transitions and version-sensitive attributes — over five purposes. Each demands a distinct decision: shared helper versus inline, cleanup-return shape, ref-guard and import-mode reversion, state-setter combinators — no single repeated rule carries them.

localization_burden.evidence: One import trace reveals all call sites, but classification combines cross-component flow: accordion callbacks registered through context between menu and submenu, style-model types traveling an export-alias chain, popper refs shared between hook and component. Surviving public helper shells and untouched utilities look equivalent yet must be excluded — plausible decoys exist.

repair_coordination.evidence: Interlocking shared rules force joint edits: the off-canvas template feeds both the media-query branch and runtime class; popper relocation ties instance reuse, effect dependencies and destroy/observation cleanup; single-open spans the menu reducer, registration and context. Changing one side alone reintroduces drift or leaks lifecycle, so locations must track each other.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Bodies moved verbatim into one module with consumers' control flow intact, so a single relocate-into-consumer pattern — restoring surviving helper shells and imports — plausibly re-homes most families without per-site behavioral decisions, roughly 60–80%. The type re-export web and popper import-mode reversion still require judgment, keeping uniform coverage under 80%.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Missed listener cleanup, observer disconnection or instance destruction compiles and passes ordinary interaction, surfacing only at unmount or resize stages; registration and first-render mistakes likewise need sibling mounts or hydration to show. Special-state failures are concrete; the material supplies no test content or execution records establishing coverage of these paths.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
